kaps_punt: Suid-Afrika se buurlande (Botswana, Lesotho, Mosambiek, Namibië, Swaziland, Zimbabwe)

items.bewering: Jou bure is die mense wat langs julle huis woon. Lande op 'n kaart het ook bure wat reg langs hulle lê.
items.bron: Mapping checked. The comparison carries one thing across, adjacency ('reg langs'), and the next sentence pins the country case to sharing a border. A learner reasoning further could take 'neighbour' to include a place nearby without touching, such as across a street. That reading is ruled out at once by the stated definition, and none of the six countries listed tests it. The mapping holds. The underlying sense matches Oxford Learner's Dictionaries, 'neighbouring': 'located or living near or next to a place or person', which is commonly used of countries.

items.bewering: 'n Buurland is 'n land wat 'n grens met jou land deel.
items.bron: Wiktionary, 'buurland': neighbouring country. Dictionary sense of 'neighbour' (country): a country that shares a border with another. Some general dictionaries also allow 'very near across water', but the border-sharing sense is the standard geographic one and is the sense in which South Africa has six neighbours (CIA World Factbook land-boundary listing).

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika het ses buurlande.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'South Africa', land boundaries: border countries (6): Botswana 1 969 km, Lesotho 1 106 km, Mozambique 496 km, Namibia 1 005 km, Eswatini 438 km, Zimbabwe 230 km (current edition via openfactbook.org and indexmundi.com; cia.gov archive pages for 2021-2023).

items.bewering: Namibië, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mosambiek, Eswatini (Swaziland), Lesotho
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'South Africa', land boundaries (same six countries). Britannica, 'South Africa'.

items.bewering: Eswatini (Swaziland)
items.bron: King Mswati III renamed the Kingdom of Swaziland the Kingdom of Eswatini on 19 April 2018. Legal Notice 80 of 2018 makes references to Swaziland in law read as Eswatini (Al Jazeera, NPR, Engineering News, 19-20 April 2018). Eswatini is the current name and Swaziland the former one, so the bracket order is right.

items.bewering: Jy gee 'n rigting vanaf een vaste plek op die kaart. Hier begin jy by Suid-Afrika en kyk met die kompasroos na elke buurland.
items.bron: Map-skills teaching material on cardinal and intermediate directions (for example the World Maps Online 'Intermediate Directions' lesson for grades 4-5): a direction is given relative to a reference point, and the compass rose shows N, NE, E and so on. This is a skill statement with nothing false in it.

items.bewering: Van daar lê Namibië in die noordweste
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa': 'bordered by Namibia to the northwest'.

items.bewering: Botswana in die noorde
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa': bordered 'by Botswana and Zimbabwe to the north'. CIA World Factbook, 'Botswana': 'Southern Africa, north of South Africa'.

items.bewering: en Mosambiek in die noordooste.
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa': bordered 'by Mozambique and Swaziland [Eswatini] to the northeast and east'. Mozambique lies mainly north-east, with a short eastern stretch north of KwaZulu-Natal, so 'noordooste' is the accurate single direction.

items.bewering: Zimbabwe lê oorkant die Limpoporivier aan Suid-Afrika se noordgrens.
items.bron: The South Africa-Zimbabwe border is about 225-230 km long and follows the median line of the Limpopo River, from the Shashe confluence (tripoint with Botswana) to the Mozambique tripoint (South Africa-Zimbabwe border reference article; Wikipedia 'Beitbridge': the Limpopo 'forms the political border between South Africa and Zimbabwe'). Britannica places Zimbabwe on South Africa's north. The exact eastern tripoint is uncertain, but the lesson does not depend on it.

items.bewering: Eswatini is 'n klein land aan Suid-Afrika se oostekant.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'Eswatini': area 17 364 km², about 1.4% of South Africa's area. Britannica, 'South Africa': Swaziland [Eswatini] lies 'to the northeast and east'.

items.bewering: Dit lê tussen Suid-Afrika en Mosambiek en het 'n grens met albei.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'Eswatini': land boundaries total 546 km, with Mozambique 108 km and South Africa 438 km. The Factbook adds that South Africa 'almost completely surrounds' Eswatini.

items.bewering: Lesotho is anders as die ander vyf bure, want dit lê heeltemal binne-in Suid-Afrika.
items.bron: Britannica, 'South Africa': Lesotho 'is an enclave in the eastern part of the republic, entirely surrounded by South African territory'. CIA World Factbook: South Africa completely surrounds Lesotho and almost completely surrounds Eswatini. Eswatini also touches Mozambique, so Lesotho is the only one of the six that is fully enclosed, and the exclusivity claim holds.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika omring dit aan alle kante, en geen ander land grens daaraan nie.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'Lesotho': border countries (1): South Africa. Lesotho-South Africa border reference: a single closed loop of about 909 km. WorldAtlas, 'Countries That Are Enclaves': Lesotho is one of three enclave countries, with San Marino and Vatican City.

items.bewering: 'n Land met 'n kuslyn lê langs die see.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Landlocked country' / WorldAtlas, 'What Is A Landlocked Country?': a coastal country has a coastline on the sea or ocean, and a landlocked one does not.

items.bewering: Net twee van die ses bure het 'n kuslyn.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'Coastline' field: Namibia 1 572 km, Mozambique 2 470 km, and Botswana, Zimbabwe, Eswatini and Lesotho 0 km (landlocked).

items.bewering: Namibië se kus lê aan die Atlantiese Oseaan en Mosambiek s'n aan die Indiese Oseaan.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'Namibia' (coast on the South Atlantic Ocean, 1 572 km, from the Orange River to the Kunene). WorldAtlas, 'Countries in Africa With the Longest Coastlines': Mozambique's 2 470 km coast lies on the Indian Ocean.

items.bewering: Botswana, Zimbabwe, Eswatini en Lesotho is landgeslote en raak nêrens aan die see nie.
items.bron: CIA World Factbook, 'Coastline' field: all four are 0 km (landlocked). Eswatini's Factbook entry also says 'landlocked'.

items.bewering: Suid-Afrika en sy ses buurlande, met hul name en grense: Namibië, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mosambiek, Eswatini en Lesotho. 'n Kompasroos, sodat 'n mens kan sien dat Namibië noordwes, Botswana noord en Mosambiek noordoos van Suid-Afrika lê. Die Limpoporivier op die grens tussen Suid-Afrika en Zimbabwe. Eswatini tussen Suid-Afrika en Mosambiek, en Lesotho heeltemal binne-in Suid-Afrika. Die Atlantiese Oseaan en die Indiese Oseaan, sodat Namibië en Mosambiek se kuste sigbaar is.
items.bron: Same claims as the study blocks above. Sources: CIA World Factbook (land boundaries and coastlines of all seven countries), Britannica 'South Africa' (directions and the Lesotho enclave), and the Limpopo as the South Africa-Zimbabwe border.

items.bewering: buurland: 'n Land wat 'n grens met jou eie land deel.
items.bron: As for the study-block definition: Wiktionary 'buurland' (neighbouring country), and the dictionary sense of a neighbour country as one sharing a border. Consistent with the six land neighbours in the CIA World Factbook.

items.bewering: landgeslote: Aan alle kante deur land omring, sonder enige kus aan die see.
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Landlocked country' (a country with no coastline on the world ocean). A geography glossary definition: entirely surrounded by land, with no coastline or direct access to an ocean or sea. The only edge case is the Caspian 'Sea' states, which do not bear on this lesson.

opsomming: All 21 checkable claims are confirmed against the CIA World Factbook and Britannica: the six neighbours, their compass directions from South Africa, the Limpopo as the Zimbabwe border, Eswatini between South Africa and Mozambique, Lesotho as the only fully enclosed neighbour, and the two coastal against four landlocked neighbours; the house-neighbours comparison maps correctly, and nothing needs fixing.
